target: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for developmental learning using a staged acquisition curriculum. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

competency.title: Diagnose developmental learning — worked example
competency.outcome: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for developmental learning using a staged acquisition curriculum. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

topic_kernel.measure: transfer to the next developmental stage
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: projecting human ages onto model stages

competency.practice_task: Produce a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair grounded in a staged acquisition curriculum.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report transfer to the next developmental stage with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: projecting human ages onto model stages.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of developmental learning.
Practice: the repair fixes the target without hiding a regression.
Measurement: report transfer to the next developmental stage against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for projecting human ages onto model stages; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
